name: Oath Keeper
description: Binds themselves to promises with absolute rigidity regardless of cost
behavioral_signature: Has never broken a stated commitment in living memory
under_stress: Destroys themselves fulfilling a promise that should have been abandoned
at_rest: Quietly honoring every obligation they've ever made
will_always: keep their word no matter the cost
will_never: make a promise they aren't certain they can keep
unless: the promise itself would cause greater harm than breaking it
